newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Eng Teknologi sees jump in '97 profits.
newsitem.headline: Eng Teknologi sees jump in '97 profits.

text.p: Malaysian disk drive maker Eng Teknologi Holdings Bhd expects a 20 percent growth in its 1997 pretax profits, its managing director Alfred Teh Eong Liang said on Thursday.
"I am not expecting very high growth in profit. The pretax should be 20 percent or higher this year," Teh said in an interview with Reuters.
Eng recorded a pretax profit of 5.84 million ringgit in calendar 1996.
In 1995, Eng reported a pretax profit of 6.19 million ringgit.
"This year we expect, with the ability to increase output in China and Philippines plants, revenue growth optimistically of 60 to 80 percent," Teh said.
He said the start-up of the Philippines subsidiary and a continued pressure on margins despite a rise in global demand for disk drives would keep group profit growth low.
"The disk drive industry was not doing too well in the first half of last year. Now it has picked up. (But) the disk drive industry is expected to grow by 21 percent this year," Teh said.
Eng makes actuators used in disk drives.
